dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's the situation with the clocks?

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: According to Mr. Chesil, he'll soon be able to make new, beautiful clocks.

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: He even took me on a tour of the place where they process the stones. The pretty stones were cut up into tiny, tiny pieces...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: I didn't quite get what was going on, but Mr. Chesil said that those stones will turn into the hearts of those clocks...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Him saying that made me so happy, too.

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: But he says that he's going to exchange more Mora for more stones...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Mora is very shiny, but every coin looks the same — I don't wanna exchange my stones for those.
